amethyst_furnace.description: Amethyst Furnace processes every registered Better Smelters furnace recipe at 15× speed while using 40% of the baseline fuel per unit of work.
amethyst_furnace.input: One registered smelting input and one supported solid fuel
amethyst_furnace.output: One smelted item per input, except Nether Star Furnace stack batches
specifications: 1 fuel slot · 1 input slot · 1 output slot
Pulled from the top; fuel slot is also exposed below
Input from the right side and output to the left side, relative to the furnace front
howItWorks: Insert a registered smelting input and a supported solid fuel.
The furnace completes a nominal cycle in 5.33 ticks while its inventory can accept the result.
Collect the result manually or from the configured output side.
io: Horizontal input sides; automatic pull uses the right side
All exposed output sides; automatic push uses the left side
